content: Better to stand bravely and fall in the light of day than to live a hundred winters groveling in the shadows.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
explanation: Mere biological longevity is not the summit of human achievement. What nobility is there in breathing for ninety years if every day was lived in cowardly compromise, betrayal of friends, and trembling compliance with tyranny? Live with radiant, uncompromising honor.
practicalInsight: Stand firm for your values today, even if it brings temporary disapproval. Choose dignity over cowardice.
reflectionPrompt: Where are you compromising your integrity just to stay comfortable and avoid rocking the boat?
